fusions.name: Flush the Quarry
fusions.desc: Sends a small biter racing to the first enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 26 damage. Every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Bigger Bark
fusions.desc: A yap that deals 7 resonating damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, with a 40% chance to leave each target [Damped] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Back to the Pack
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and 1% more for each 1% of cast speed you have. It also scampers you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Hand That Feeds
fusions.desc: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
